locator.text: Equation (5.7), p. 47, in the proof of Lemma 5.1

evidence: paper: K_n = \mathcal{A}_X(U_n) - U_n, \qquad W_n = (\phi_n, U_n, K_n, \Pi_n, \partial_\xi \phi_n, \partial_\xi U_n)^{\mathsf{T}}, \\ \partial_\xi W_n + \xi^{-1}\,\mathrm{diag}(0,0,2,0,3,1)\,W_n = A_0 W_n + A_1 \partial_\eta W_n + f_n, \qquad W_n(0) = 0.

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Every piece of (5.7) is present, with two routine re-encodings. (i) The singular system is literal: `JetSystem` is ∂_ξ W + diag(0,0,2,0,3,1)·W/ξ = A₀W + A₁(∂_η W) + f with `diagonal = ![0,0,2,0,3,1]`, and `IsPositiveOrderSolution.equation` restates it for the actual solution field with `exponent` in place of `diagonal` (`diagonal_eq_exponent` proves the two agree). `equationRHS` is exactly f + A₀W + A₁∂_ηW. The axis condition W_n(0)=0 is `IsRegularSolution.axis_zero` (W 0 z = 0) and `IsPositiveOrderSolution.profiles_zero`. (ii) Components 5 and 6 of the Lean vector are `2*r*phi.radial` and `2*r*u.radial`, i.e. 2ξ∂_X φ_n and 2ξ∂_X U_n; with X = ξ² these are ∂_ξ φ_n and ∂_ξ U_n, the paper's entries. (iii) The paper's algebraic definition K_n = 𝒜_X(U_n) − U_n is carried in Lean by the differentiated average row X(∂_X U_n + ∂_X K_n) + K_n = 0 inside `ExpandedEquations`/`JetSystem` (row 3), together with `averageDefect u = average u − u`; `averageDefect_radial` shows the defect satisfies that row and `averageDefect_unique` shows the row plus smoothness forces k = averageDefect u, so the two formulations coincide. (iv) The last two entries of the Lean parameter vector are free variables q₄,q₅ rather than ∂_η of the last two components of W; `A1_high_parameters_irrelevant` shows A₁ annihilates them, so the product A₁∂_ηW_n is unaffected. The Lean differential form is stated only for r ≠ 0; the behaviour at the axis is carried by the equivalent integral equation, which is also how the paper uses it.
